rca_of_issue: P0 bug FIXED: DrumTimePicker was previously showing only in the bottom half of the screen because it was rendered inside a bottom-sheet Modal (transparent=true, flex:end). Fix replaced the single conditional Modal with two separate Modals: (1) bottom sheet Modal with visible={showDayModal && !showPicker} and (2) full-screen picker Modal with visible={showPicker} and transparent={false}. This ensures the picker gets full-screen coverage with its own root Modal context.
